games.title: Dwarf Fortress gets its first Myth and Magic update later this year, bringing each player's world its own procedural magic system
games.excerpt: Dwarf Fortress's long-promised Myth and Magic update will generate a bespoke magic system per world — procedural generation as authored design, not model output.

games.ko: 게임 속 AI 아트를 가려내는 건 결국 시각적 문해력의 문제다 생성형 AI 그림을 알아보는 눈은 타고나는 게 아니라 훈련으로 길러진다.
games.title: "Hopefully a meteor will strike the earth soon": Game devs talk genAI witchhunts and the importance of honing your visual literacy
games.excerpt: Failbetter, New Blood and other game developers on the importance of honing your visual (and technical) literacy if you want to effectively spot — and fight — genAI art in games.

games.ko: 방 수천 개를 끊김 없이 잇는 유니티 던전 생성 알고리즘 라이언 카펜터가 2년을 매달린 유니티 던전 생성기가 웹 데모로 공개됐다.
games.title: Unity-Based Algorithm For Seamless Dungeon Generation
games.excerpt: A developer shared the Labyrinth Procedural Generator, a Unity algorithm that stitches dungeon rooms into seamless, playable layouts, with a live demo to try. Learn how the Labyrinth Procedural Generator works and try the demo.

games.ko: 유니티 스타일라이즈드 워터 3에 스플라인 강 모델러가 붙는다 리버 모델러가 스타일라이즈드 워터 3 전용 확장으로 처음부터 다시 만들어진다.
games.title: Unity's Stylized Water 3 Is Getting Spline-Based River Modeler Tool
games.excerpt: Stylized Water 3 is adding a spline-driven river modeler for Unity. It's designed around Burst and the Job System, features segmented river output, and automatic VFX/SFX integration.

games.ko: AI 이용자를 차단한 위키가 디도스 공격에 멈춰 섰다 미공개 게임 자료를 모아온 위키 TCRF가 디도스 공격으로 접속을 차단했다.
games.title: DDoS Attack Breaks Beloved Video Game Wiki After AI Bro Was Banned
games.excerpt: The Cutting Room Floor wiki went offline after a DDoS attack allegedly triggered by a contributor banned for using Claude Code. The site had already deployed anti-AI defenses, including MS Paint warnings served to scrapers.

games.ko: 트위치·아마존이 스트리머 방송을 AI 학습에 썼다며 집단소송 워런 판디샤는 동의도 대가도 없이 자기 방송이 AI 학습에 쓰였다고 주장한다.
games.title: Twitch faces a class action lawsuit over using streamers' content to train Amazon's AI
games.excerpt: Twitch content creator Warren Pandiscia has filed a proposed class action against Twitch and Amazon, alleging the companies used streamers' content to train AI.

games.ko: 모바일은 AI를 끌어안고 트리플A는 뒤로 물러선다 PGC 서밋 상하이 패널은 격차의 원인을 제작 리스크와 관객의 기대에서 찾았다.
games.title: The AI paradox: why mobile embraces AI and triple-A holds back
games.excerpt: At PGC Summit Shanghai, studio leaders and investors asked why free-to-play mobile races to adopt AI in production while triple-A holds back. The panel maps where AI is actually landing in game pipelines and where it stalls.

games.ko: Inworld, TTS 평가 도구를 오픈소스로 공개 로컬 ASR과 명시적 정규화, 샘플 단위 측정으로 결과를 원본 오디오까지 되짚을 수 있다.
games.title: Inworld TTS Open Evaluation Toolkit: Reproducible TTS Evals
games.excerpt: Inworld open-sourced a framework for reproducible text-to-speech evaluation: local ASR, explicit normalization, per-sample measurements and offline reports that can be traced back to the source audio.

games.ko: GTA 6의 군중 기술은 10년쯤 앞서 있다 경쟁작 군중을 만든 개발자는 GTA 6의 NPC 군중 기술이 업계보다 10년쯤 앞섰다고 말했다.
games.title: Rockstar is 'at least 10 years ahead' of other games with GTA 6's NPC crowd technology, says dev behind 007 First Light's crowds
games.excerpt: A developer who built the crowd systems in 007 First Light says Rockstar's GTA 6 NPC crowd technology puts it roughly a decade ahead of the rest of the industry, in simulation depth rather than generative shortcuts.

games.ko: 1666: Amsterdam이 생성형 AI를 걷어냈다 반발이 이어지자 스튜디오는 생성형 AI를 뺐고, 쓰인 곳은 기획과 프리프로덕션뿐이었다.
games.title: 1666: Amsterdam's developer says it 'won't be using any AI anymore', and the tech was only used 'in conception and pre-production'
games.excerpt: Assassin's Creed creator Patrice Desilets says his studio has dropped generative AI from 1666: Amsterdam after backlash, and that the tech had only been used in conception and pre-production — arguably the most creative phase of the whole process.

games.ko: 모델 데모와 출시 사이에 남는 운영 문제 AWS의 Huang Zhoubin은 데모와 출시 사이에 놓인 인프라와 워크플로 문제를 짚는다.
games.title: AI powering the global engine for game studios
games.excerpt: AWS senior gaming solutions architecture manager Huang Zhoubin breaks down how studios are actually operationalising AI — the infrastructure, workflow and production problems that sit between a model demo and a shipped feature.

games.ko: City Sample이 5.8로 다시 지어졌다 레벨을 새로 짠 City Sample에 절차적 생성과 에이전트 편집 워크플로가 함께 담겼다.
games.title: City Sample gets a major update with PCG and Unreal MCP workflows
games.excerpt: Epic's City Sample project has been rebuilt for Unreal Engine 5.8 with entirely new levels, plus additional toolsets, content and examples for procedural worldbuilding — including PCG and Unreal MCP (agent-driven editor) workflows.

games.ko: 프롬프트 세 단어가 카트가 되는 Roblox 레이싱 게임이 나왔다 플레이어가 고른 형용사 세 개를 Cube AI가 3D 카트로 만들어 경주에 태운다.
games.title: How Dream Racers uses Roblox's Cube AI to generate playable vehicles in real time
games.excerpt: A new Roblox game, Dream Racers, integrates generative AI directly into gameplay by letting players build and race unique karts. It is one of the first shipped titles to put Roblox's Cube 3D generation model into a live player-facing loop.

games.ko: Unity 에디터 안에서 프롬프트로 게임을 고치는 도구가 9월 7일 나온다 9월 7일 나올 Nimble Fox는 Unity 프로젝트를 읽고 기능별로 고친다.
games.title: Nimble Fox launches AI tool for building Unity games worldwide
games.excerpt: A Helsinki startup is releasing an AI copilot built into the Unity editor on Sept. 7, letting developers build and modify games by prompting inside the engine. Rather than generating a whole game in one pass, it works feature by feature — mechanics, UI flows, scoped changes — reading the context of an existing project.

games.ko: AI의 진짜 문제는 도구가 아니라 그걸 쓰라고 강요하는 상사다 Tarn Adams는 AI의 문제로 도구가 아니라 사용을 강요하는 상사를 지목했다.
games.title: Dwarf Fortress Creator Calls Out One Of AI's Biggest Issues: The Bosses Who Force Us To Use It
games.excerpt: Tarn Adams argues the real problem with generative AI in game development isn't the tools but mandated adoption: 'Everyone I know, their bosses are slowly getting psychosis.'

games.ko: AI가 거든 PS1 Quake보다 손으로 짠 옛 포팅이 나았다 AI가 거든 PS1 Quake 포팅보다 AI를 안 쓴 옛 QuakePSX가 나았다.
games.title: 30 years later, I finally got to play Quake on the PS1, but that's before I found a better version that doesn't rely on "substantial AI assistance"
games.excerpt: A homebrew Quake port for PS1 was built with heavy AI coding assistance — and a rival hand-written port runs better, sparking a small but pointed comparison in the demoscene-adjacent porting community.

games.ko: Nvidia가 밝힌 DLSS 5의 값은 평균 프레임 50-60% 하락이다 Nvidia는 DLSS 5가 모든 게임에서 프레임을 50-60% 깎는다고 밝혔다.
games.title: Nvidia says DLSS 5 comes with a 50-60% performance hit, which makes me wonder what we're doing here
games.excerpt: Nvidia has confirmed DLSS 5's 3D-guided neural rendering costs 50-60% of frame rate on average, inverting the original promise of DLSS as a performance technology.

games.ko: 음악을 넣으면 조명과 카메라가 알아서 박자를 타는 UE5 플러그인 키프레임 없이 오디오만 물리면 조명과 카메라, 파티클이 각자 다른 소리를 따라간다.
games.title: Create Procedural UE5 Animations Based on Music with Vizibeat
games.excerpt: Vizibeat is an Unreal Engine plug-in that drives procedural animation directly from an audio track, producing motion without any keyframing.

games.ko: 스튜디오 소속 화가 그림만 학습해 기기 안에서 돌리는 게임 AI 프로토타입 열 개를 만든 끝에 AI 자유도를 낮추고 설계한 규칙 안에 가뒀다.
games.title: New Game Uses Local AI Model Trained Entirely on Studio's Own Artists
games.excerpt: Studio Atelico built more than 10 prototypes around a local, on-device model trained only on its own artists' work. The takeaways: authored constraints, artist consent, statistical testing, and tighter creative-technical collaboration.

It follows RyzaChat:AI, which has logged more than 15 million spoken interactions and generates quests from conversation. (Off-list outlet: no on-list outlet covered it.)

games.ko: 넥슨게임즈 Pareidolia, 온디바이스 음성 AI로 캐릭터를 부른다 모바일 발열과 성능에 맞춘 자체 음성인식 AI가 기기 안에서만 돌아간다.

The show's AI Technology Pavilion also showcased pipeline tools such as Mesh AI's image-to-3D model generation.

games.ko: 이매지네이션 NSR, 모바일 GPU에서 540p를 1080p로 2.3ms에 AI 연산을 GPU 안에서 처리하고 Unreal·Godot 지원도 준비한다.

games.excerpt: Imagination Technologies unveiled Neural Super Resolution (NSR), an AI upscaler for mobile games that reconstructs 540p frames to 1080p in as little as 2.3ms on a single-core E-Series GPU, running the AI work inside the GPU itself. Imagination plans to add NSR to its PowerVR SDK and support it in Unreal Engine and Godot, with W4 Games backing the launch.

movies.excerpt: StoReel launched Canvas, an agent-powered AI production platform that turns a script into scene breakdowns, storyboards, character/setting references and optimized prompts for leading AI video models. The company claims it cuts production time by roughly two-thirds at about 15% of live-action cost.

movies.ko: 생성형 AI로 그려낸 단편 한 편을 두고 안시 2026이 야유와 퇴장으로 들썩였다 히스코 휠싱이 자신의 그림을 본떠 AI로 만든 '당스 마카브르'에 관객들은 야유하거나 자리를 떴다.
movies.excerpt: Variety's recap of the record-breaking Annecy 2026 festival, where Hisko Hulsing's generative-AI short 'Danse Macabre' became the most-discussed film, drawing protest stickers, walkouts and booing as the industry wrestles with AI in animation.

movies.ko: 어도비가 토파즈랩스를 인수하며 AI 영상·이미지 보정을 품는다 에미상을 받은 토파즈랩스의 업스케일링과 복원 기술을 파이어플라이에 통합한다.
movies.excerpt: Adobe has signed an agreement to acquire Topaz Labs, bringing its Emmy Award-winning AI video and image enhancement technology - upscaling, sharpening, frame interpolation, noise removal and footage restoration - in-house, while keeping Topaz products available as standalone tools.

movies.ko: 저해상도 옛 영상을 4K로 되살리는 로컬 AI 복원 도구 아이아티 클라우드에 올리지 않고 PC에서 노이즈를 없애고 디테일을 복원해 4K로 키운다.
movies.title: Aiarty Video Enhancer: local AI upscaling that restores low-res footage to 4K
movies.excerpt: Aiarty Video Enhancer applies AI-driven denoising, detail reconstruction and 4K upscaling to restore low-resolution and legacy footage for modern production workflows. All processing runs locally, with no cloud upload required.

movies.ko: 픽사 출신 감독이 딥마인드와 손잡고 프롬프트 없이 완성한 애니메이션 코니 허 감독은 딥마인드와 함께 프롬프트 없이 회화풍 하이브리드 애니메이션을 만들었다.
movies.excerpt: Pixar alum director Connie He details the hybrid workflow behind her Tribeca short 'Dear Upstairs Neighbors,' blending traditional animation with a custom Google DeepMind video-to-video model. She used AI not for efficiency but to unlock a painterly visual style, keeping tight control over performance, timing, and rhythm.

movies.ko: 아마존이 내려놓은 AI 영화 '아티피셜', 네온 품에 안기다 샘 올트먼 해임극을 다룬 과다니노 신작 판권을 아마존 MGM 대신 네온이 가져갔다.
movies.excerpt: Luca Guadagnino's film "Artificial" — which explores AI and human connection — is in talks with Neon for distribution after Amazon MGM decided it would be better served elsewhere, creating an unlikely irony: an AI-themed film losing its AI-forward studio. The story reflects Hollywood's deep ambivalence about AI-themed content.

movies.ko: 건국 250주년 다큐, 생성 AI로 역사 속 흑인들에게 얼굴을 돌려주다 실제 초상화에 기반한 유화를 AI로 움직여 독립전쟁기 흑인 네 명을 되살렸다.
movies.excerpt: For the US 250th anniversary, the documentary "Declarations: Black Americans and the Revolutionary War" used generative AI to animate and voice historical subjects — premiering June 29 on PBS. The filmmakers argue the technology enables a form of historical representation previously impossible with traditional archival methods.

movies.ko: 크레딧 없는 작업이 80%, AI는 할리우드의 새로운 성형수술이다 관객 반발이 두려운 스튜디오들 탓에 AI 작업 5건 중 4건이 크레딧 없이 묻힌다.
movies.excerpt: An AI technology company's contributions go uncredited on nearly 80% of the Hollywood projects it completes, as studios fear audience backlash even for legitimate uses that improve quality and workflow — not generative slop. The piece examines how AI's cosmetic secrecy is distorting the industry's public conversation.

movies.ko: AI는 낡은 아이디어의 조합 우리는 HI, 인간 지능이다 낸터킷 공로상 무대에서 생성 AI를 낡은 경험의 조합이라 부르며 HI를 내세웠다.
movies.title: AI Just Collects 'Our Old Ideas', Paul Feig Declares; 'We Are HI: Human Intelligence'
movies.excerpt: Writer-director Paul Feig ('Bridesmaids') derided generative AI as 'an amalgamation of our old ideas,' arguing that the technology can only recombine what humans already made and coining 'HI — human intelligence' as the industry's real engine.

movies.ko: F1은 AI가 만든 영화 아니냐는 조디 포스터의 뼈 있는 농담 아스펜 무대에서 브래드 피트의 F1을 AI가 썼을 법한 영화라고 웃으며 꼬집었다.
movies.title: Jodie Foster Says Brad Pitt's 'F1' Seemed Like It Was Made by AI and Written by a Computer: 'Wasn't It?'
movies.excerpt: At the Aspen Festival of Ideas talk 'Who Owns the Future of Hollywood,' Jodie Foster quipped that Apple's blockbuster 'F1' seemed like it could have been made by AI and written by a computer. She allowed that AI tools are useful for 'small helpful things' like previs, while questioning formula-driven studio filmmaking in the AI era.

movies.ko: 60회 카를로비바리 영화제 주 무대에 오른 AI 실전 수업 7월 5~8일 인더스트리 데이즈에서 영화인이 쓸 수 있는 AI 도구를 직접 시연한다.
movies.title: 'The Sopranos' Creator David Chase, Jude Law's Riff Raff, Demystifying AI: KVIFF Industry Days Primer
movies.excerpt: Karlovy Vary's expanded Industry Days (July 5-8) puts 'demystifying AI' on the main stage: a hands-on presentation of currently available AI tools for film professionals, plus sessions on microdramas and other disruption threats, per KVIFF Film Industry Office head Hugo Rosak. The 60th edition frames AI literacy as a core skill for European film pros.

movies.ko: 죽은 아들을 닮은 안드로이드 고레에다 신작 예고편 공개 네온이 7월 24일 개봉할 고레에다의 애도극 '십 인 더 박스' 예고편을 공개했다.
movies.title: 'Sheep in the Box' Trailer: Hirokazu Koreeda Makes a Plea for Imagination in the AI Age with Sci-Fi Grief Drama
movies.excerpt: Neon released the trailer for Hirokazu Koreeda's Cannes-premiered sci-fi grief drama 'Sheep in the Box' (in US theaters July 24), in which a Japanese couple welcomes an AI-powered android re-creation of their deceased son into their home — Koreeda's plea for human imagination in the AI age.

movies.ko: 영 워싱턴은 어디에 AI를 썼나 존 어윈이 장면별로 풀어놨다 얼음 강 조난부터 영국군 병사까지 감독 존 어윈이 100여 컷의 AI 활용을 장면별로 짚었다.
movies.title: 'Young Washington' Director Jon Erwin Breaks Down Film's Use of AI
movies.excerpt: Jon Erwin walks through exactly how his July 4th-weekend historical drama 'Young Washington' used generative AI, scene by scene. The production employed five AI artists plus an AI producer and crew member, with Erwin arguing the tech made the shoot 'safer and more affordable.' The film opened nationwide July 3 and is over-performing at the box office.

movies.ko: 퀼은 사랑받고 매그니픽은 외면받은 마드리드 넥스트 랩 피칭 현장 여섯 팀 모두 의무로 썼지만 퀼만 남고 매그니픽은 대부분 도중에 내려놨다.
movies.title: Next Lab Generation Required Filmmakers to Use Quill and Magnific — Most Embraced VR but Ditched AI
movies.excerpt: The Next Lab Generation program required its six finalist teams to develop pitches using Meta's Quill VR animation software and the Magnific AI upscaler before pitching in Madrid. Cartoon Brew's rundown of the finalist projects finds most teams leaned into VR workflows while quietly dropping the mandated AI tool.

movies.ko: 일감이 마른 할리우드 작가들 AI를 가르치는 부업으로 버틴다 일감이 마르자 베테랑 작가와 편집자들이 자기 일을 위협하는 AI를 다듬는 RLHF 부업에 나섰다.
movies.title: Hollywood Workers Are Training AI Models as Job Prospects Grow Slim
movies.excerpt: With film and TV work drying up, veteran writers and crew are taking RLHF gigs — rating and refining generative AI outputs for tech companies. THR profiles workers who are effectively polishing the systems that may render their old jobs obsolete.

movies.ko: 런웨이 에이전트 2.0 공개 영상 생성에서 캠페인 운영까지 광고 지표를 읽고 다음 캠페인 소재까지 만들어 내는 마케팅 에이전트로 확장됐다.
movies.title: Runway Introduces Agent 2.0 — Prompt-to-Finished-Campaign Video Production
movies.excerpt: Runway's Agent 2.0 goes from a single prompt to a planned multi-shot sequence with consistency locking, voice/music integration and a rough assembled cut — an 'autonomous production assistant' the user supervises, now extended into campaign creation and performance analysis.

movies.ko: 논란의 AI 배우 틸리 노우드 첫 장편 '미스얼라인드'로 데뷔 할리우드를 들끓게 한 AI 배우가 '미스얼라인드'로 첫 장편 주연에 나선다.
movies.title: Tilly Norwood to Lead New Movie 'Misaligned,' Marking Feature Debut for AI 'Actor'
movies.excerpt: AI 'actor' Tilly Norwood, who ignited industry-wide anger in late 2025, will front her first feature — 'Misaligned,' a comedy-drama set in the surreal 'Tillyverse.' Creator studio Particle 6 says it has 'retrained and upskilled' 30+ film and TV creatives since launch.

movies.ko: 스파이크 리가 쓴 '어파트' 시그래프 애니 페스티벌 최고상 수상작 세 편과 함께 딥마인드의 AI 보조 애니메이션 제작기 세션도 무대에 오른다.
movies.title: 'Apart' Wins Best in Show at SIGGRAPH 2026 Computer Animation Festival
movies.excerpt: SIGGRAPH 2026 (July 19-23, LA) named its CAF winners — 'Apart,' 'Beyond Words,' '18 Months' — and unveiled Production Sessions with Weta FX, ILM, Pixar and Google DeepMind, including the artist-centered AI-assisted workflow behind 'Dear Upstairs Neighbors.'

movies.ko: 촬영 직전 주인공이 떠난 다큐 AI로 얼굴을 지우고 완성했다 주연이 촬영 직전 물러나자 감독은 AI로 얼굴을 익명화해 영화를 이어 갔다.
movies.title: 'My Friend the Porn Star' Trailer: Doc Using AI to Anonymize Its Subject Premieres at Karlovy Vary
movies.excerpt: Rosa Friedrich's doc-erotic hybrid premieres in KVIFF's Proxima competition July 7. When her subject withdrew before shooting, Friedrich used AI to anonymize his footage, turning the film into a collective experiment on visibility and desire.

movies.ko: AI로 애니메 한 편 만드는 법 큐리어스 레퓨지의 단계별 공개 스타일 레퍼런스부터 4K 업스케일까지 애니메 제작 전 과정을 단계별로 보여 준다.
movies.title: Here's How I Built an Anime Using AI (Step-by-Step) (video)
movies.excerpt: The AI-filmmaking school walks through a complete anime-style production pipeline built on current gen-video tools — from character design and voice consistency to shot assembly — as a reproducible step-by-step workflow.

movies.ko: 7,500만 달러 딥마인드 협력 A24는 무엇을 얻고 무엇을 거는가 스토리보드 도구와 연구 인력 등 A24가 계약으로 얻는 것을 하나씩 따져 본다.
movies.title: What You Need to Know About A24's Partnership with Google DeepMind
movies.excerpt: No Film School unpacks A24's $75M research partnership with Google DeepMind — what the studio actually gets (AI storyboard tools, DeepMind researchers working alongside filmmakers) and whether the 'AI is infecting Hollywood' panic fits the facts.

movies.ko: SDR 영상에서 HDR을 복원하는 비블의 새 AI 모델 스위치HDR SDR 영상에서 사라진 하이라이트와 그림자를 되살려 16비트 EXR로 뽑아낸다.
movies.title: Beeble Releases SwitchHDR, an AI Model for HDR Reconstruction From SDR Video
movies.excerpt: Beeble has released SwitchHDR, a new frontier AI model that reconstructs HDR imagery from conventional SDR video — promising a way to bring dynamic range into footage that never had it, for post, delivery and restoration workflows.

movies.ko: 미드저니, 스튜디오의 AI 사용을 저작권 소송의 증거로 꺼내 든다 디즈니 등 스튜디오의 내부 AI 사용 자료를 공개하라며 법원 결정에 불복했다.
movies.title: Midjourney Seeks to Reveal Studios' Use of AI in High-Stakes Copyright Battle
movies.excerpt: Midjourney is appealing a magistrate judge's order limiting discovery into how Disney, Universal and Warner Bros. themselves use AI in their shows and movies, seeking to put studios' internal AI use on the record as part of its fair-use defense.

movies.ko: 아동 성우의 목소리까지 AI로 하스브로 계약 조항에 업계 반발 아동 성우 목소리의 AI 사용을 계약으로 못 박으려던 하스브로에 업계가 반발했다.
movies.title: Hasbro's TV Contracts Allegedly Ask Child Voice Actors to Sign Rights Away for AI Use
movies.excerpt: Hasbro's contracts for shows including Peppa Pig allegedly ask child voice actors to sign away rights for AI use of their voices; a UK agents' association warns a parent's approval 'should never be a blanket licence to capture, clone, train, or reuse a child's voice indefinitely.'

movies.ko: 400개 VFX 숏을 감당할 방법 코리도어 크루의 AI 워크플로 AI 리라이팅과 자체 키잉 도구로 기존 그린스크린 공정 없이 배우를 합성했다.
movies.title: So we invented a way to cheat... (Corridor Crew's AI VFX workflow with Beeble)
movies.excerpt: Corridor Crew reveals the AI VFX workflow behind their new season: Beeble's SwitchLight AI relighting plus their own CorridorKey keying let them composite actors into scenes without a traditional green-screen pipeline.

movies.ko: 마이클 케인의 AI 목소리를 두고 '위험'을 경고한 하비 케이텔 하비 케이텔이 배우가 목소리를 AI에 파는 흐름을 두고 위험이 눈앞에 있다고 경고했다.
movies.title: Harvey Keitel Shooting Film by Daphna Kastner, Denounces AI 'Danger'
movies.excerpt: Harvey Keitel, shooting a new film written by Daphna Kastner, warns of the 'danger' in actors like Michael Caine licensing their voices to AI — the latest flashpoint in the performer-likeness debate.

movies.ko: 극장 개봉이 취소되고 디지털로 직행하는 M3GAN 스핀오프 소울메이트 유니버설의 M3GAN 스핀오프 소울메이트가 극장 개봉을 접고 8월 1일 디지털로 직행한다.
movies.title: 'M3GAN' Spinoff 'Soulm8te' Goes Straight to Digital After Theatrical Release Pulled, Trailer Unveils Killer Robot Girlfriend
movies.excerpt: Universal's 'M3GAN' AI-robot spinoff 'Soulm8te' unveils its killer-robot-girlfriend trailer and moves to a straight-to-digital release (August 1) after being pulled from the theatrical calendar.

movies.ko: 생성형 AI와 뉴럴 렌더링이 뒤덮은 시그래프 2026 미리 보기 7월 19일 로스앤젤레스에서 열리는 시그래프 2026이 뉴럴 렌더링과 생성형 AI 흐름을 예고한다.
movies.title: Days of Future Shock: What to Expect at SIGGRAPH 2026
movies.excerpt: A preview of SIGGRAPH 2026 (July 19-23, Los Angeles) as a snapshot of the new technologies — from generative AI to neural rendering — impacting the animation and VFX worlds this year.

movies.ko: '편집해 줘' 한마디로 타임라인을 통째로 맡기는 AI 영상 편집기 클로드 기반 AI 편집기 팔미에가 미디어 정리부터 B롤 생성까지 편집을 대신한다고 소개한다.
movies.title: AI Can FINALLY Edit Videos For You
movies.excerpt: A hands-on look at new AI video-editing agents that take over timeline editing work, and what that means for editors' workflows. Upload date verified via watch-page JSON-LD (2026-07-07T17:09:25-07:00).

movies.title: What Is Seedance 2.5 and What Can It Do
movies.excerpt: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model, now usable in Krea, generates complete 30-second clips at up to 4K from a single prompt, adding stronger reference support and region-level editing over the prior version — a jump in controllable AI video for creative teams.

movies.ko: 리프트·감마·게인 대신 존으로 색을 다루는 프리미어 컬러 모드 프리미어 베타 컬러 모드가 리프트·감마·게인 대신 존 기반으로 로그·HDR 영상의 색을 잡는다.
movies.title: Color Mode in Premiere (beta): a zone-based color-grading overhaul, not lift/gamma/gain
movies.excerpt: A deep dive into Premiere's new beta Color Mode, which replaces the traditional lift/gamma/gain model with a zone-based system built for log footage, wide-gamut media and HDR — Adobe's biggest color-grading rethink in the NLE in a decade.

movies.ko: 어도비가 AI 업스케일링 강자 토파즈 랩스를 인수한다 어도비가 토파즈 랩스를 인수해 그 업스케일링·복원 AI를 파이어플라이에 담는다.
movies.title: Adobe acquires Topaz Labs, folding leading AI upscaling/restoration tools into Creative Cloud
movies.excerpt: Adobe signed a definitive agreement to acquire Texas-based Topaz Labs, whose AI tools cover upscaling, sharpening, stabilization, frame interpolation, noise removal and footage restoration (Topaz Video, Gigapixel, Astra, Bloom). Adobe plans to bring the enhancement models into Firefly, Firefly Services and Creative Cloud, with Topaz's on-device Neurostream tech.

movies.ko: 여러 AI 모델을 한 API로 잇는 런웨이 데브 개발자 플랫폼 런웨이 데브가 최신 영상·이미지·오디오 모델을 한 API로 묶어 코드 한 줄로 바꿔 쓰게 한다.
movies.title: Runway Dev: one API to plug frontier image, video, audio and character models into any app
movies.excerpt: Runway Dev is a new AI media platform for developers: a single API to integrate the best image, video, audio and real-time character models, giving access to Runway's frontier models (Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Act-Two) alongside third-party models like Seedance, GPT Image 2 and ElevenLabs, swappable by changing one line of code.

movies.ko: 타임라인에서 바로 영상과 효과음을 만드는 프리미어 생성 미디어 도구 프리미어 베타 생성 미디어 도구가 타임라인에서 프롬프트로 영상과 효과음을 바로 만든다.
movies.title: Adobe Premiere adds a Generative Media Tool: type a prompt on the timeline to make video and sound effects
movies.excerpt: Scott Simmons details Premiere's new (beta) Generative Media Tool, which lets editors create generative video and sound effects directly in the timeline by dragging across empty space or double-clicking to type a prompt — Adobe's continued generative-AI push inside the dominant NLE.

movies.ko: 블렌더 스튜디오가 생성 AI 없이 만드는 오픈소스 장편 애니메이션 블렌더 스튜디오가 클라우드도 생성 AI도 쓰지 않고 오픈소스 도구만으로 장편 애니메이션에 도전한다.
movies.title: Blender Studio Announces Ambitious Feature Film Project
movies.excerpt: Blender Studio unveils 'Overgrown', an open-source, artist-centric large-scale animated feature explicitly built without cloud services or generative AI — pitched as a craft-forward counter-model to AI production pipelines.

movies.ko: 메타가 무료로 공개한 이미지 모델 '뮤즈'와 직접 만든 무료 영상 도구 메타가 무료 이미지 모델 뮤즈를 공개했지만 나노 바나나 2의 자리는 아직 굳건하다.
movies.title: Meta's FREE "Banana Killer" & My AI Video Tool (Also Free!)
movies.excerpt: Theoretically Media covers Meta's newly shipped free Muse Image model (positioned as a Nano-Banana rival) plus a free AI video tool, breaking down what the releases mean for AI filmmakers' toolkits.

movies.ko: 세네갈·감비아 구전 설화를 AI로 옮긴 '공주와 뱀' 예고편 세네갈과 감비아 구전 설화를 AI 영상으로 옮긴 단편의 공식 예고편이 공개됐다.
movies.title: The Princess and the Serpent | Official Trailer (Senegalese AI Folk Tale)
movies.excerpt: An AI-generated official trailer for a Senegalese folk-tale film, showcasing how independent creators use generative video to realize a culturally specific narrative and world at trailer polish.

movies.ko: 엔비디아, SIGGRAPH 2026에서 신경 렌더링·월드 모델 기조연설 엔비디아 연구진이 SIGGRAPH 2026 기조연설에서 신경 렌더링과 AI 월드 모델을 선보인다.
movies.title: NVIDIA 'Neural Rendering, World Models and Simulation' Keynote Set for SIGGRAPH 2026
movies.excerpt: NVIDIA Research and Engineering leaders Neil Ashton, Ming-Yu Liu and Edward Liu will present the sponsored keynote 'Next Era of Graphics - Neural Rendering, World Models, and Simulation' at SIGGRAPH 2026 on July 20. The talk spotlights breakthrough neural rendering techniques and AI-built world models/simulation reshaping the computer graphics and VFX pipelines filmmakers depend on.

movies.ko: AI 영화감독 사이먼 마이어가 꼽은 덜 알려진 AI 제작 도구 다섯 AI 영화감독 사이먼 마이어가 촬영 워크플로를 바꾼 덜 알려진 AI 제작 도구 다섯 개를 소개한다.
movies.title: Top 5 Secret A.I. Filmmaking Tools JULY 2026
movies.excerpt: AI filmmaker Simon Meyer rounds up five lesser-known AI filmmaking tools for July 2026, walking through how each slots into a practical shot-by-shot generative-video workflow - a creator-medium look at the current AI film toolchain.

movies.ko: AI는 허용하되 사용 구간은 공개하라 1천만 엔 걸린 SSFF 피치 공모전 쇼트쇼츠 필름페스티벌 아시아가 피치에 생성 AI를 허용하되 어느 대목에 썼는지 공개하도록 했다.
movies.title: Want ¥10 Million to Make Your Next Short? SSFF & ASIA Just Launched a Massive Pitch Competition
movies.excerpt: Short Shorts Film Festival & Asia opened a pitch competition offering ¥10 million in production funding for a winning short drama, permitting generative AI in pitch materials but requiring filmmakers to disclose exactly which sections used AI. A window into how major festivals are writing AI-disclosure rules into creative submissions.

movies.ko: AI 배우 틸리 노우드가 장편 영화 주연을 맡는다 AI 배우 틸리 노우드가 파티클6의 첫 장편 '미스얼라인드'에서 주연을 맡는다고 버라이어티가 전했다.
movies.title: AI golem Tilly Norwood is reportedly 'starring' in a feature-length movie
movies.excerpt: The AI-generated 'actress' Tilly Norwood is reportedly set to headline a feature called 'Misaligned' from Particle6 Productions — a 'coming-of-age story infused with existential AI chaos' set in the 'Tillyverse.' The move escalates the synthetic-performer fight (SAG-AFTRA: 'not an actor'), a live test of AI likeness/casting in narrative film.

movies.ko: 수만 달러로 만든 135분 AI 영화 놀란의 2억 5천만 오디세이에 맞선다 애시 쿠샤 감독이 클링으로 만든 135분짜리 AI 오디세이가 올여름 웹에서 편당 9.99달러에 공개된다.
movies.title: AI-Generated Odyssey Movie Costing a Few Thousand Dollars Unveiled Ahead of Nolan's $250 Million Feature
movies.excerpt: Fountain O unveiled 'Odysseus: The Fall,' a 135-minute AI-generated retelling of Homer's epic by director Ash Koosha, made for a mid-five-figure budget using Kling after OpenAI shuttered Sora. It launches to piggyback on Christopher Nolan's $250M traditional adaptation, dramatizing how generative video collapses feature-film budgets and workflows.

movies.ko: 숏폼 마이크로드라마를 위한 AI 네이티브 제작 플랫폼 비글루가 마이크로드라마 제작의 기획부터 후반까지를 한 환경에 담은 AI 네이티브 플랫폼을 내놨다.
movies.title: Vigloo Studio: an AI-native production platform for short-form microdramas
movies.excerpt: Vigloo launched Vigloo Studio, an AI-native production platform built for creators of serialized short-form (microdrama) storytelling, consolidating fragmented pre-to-post workflows into a single environment for episodic drama creation. A concrete example of AI restructuring how short-form narrative content is produced end to end.

movies.ko: '테드' 시즌 2, AI 얼굴 교체를 주류 VFX 파이프라인에 녹이다 '테드' 시즌 2가 딥부두의 자체 소프트웨어로 세스 맥팔레인을 시대에 맞는 빌 클린턴 얼굴로 교체했다.
movies.title: How Ted Season 2 blended AI face tools into a mainstream episodic VFX pipeline
movies.excerpt: For Ted Season 2, the team blended AI, CG, real-time tools and digital environments, using Deep Voodoo's proprietary software to build a period-accurate Bill Clinton head replacement for Seth MacFarlane that captured speech and facial nuance beyond traditional CG. Shows how generative/AI face tools are entering mainstream episodic VFX pipelines.

movies.ko: 라이다와 가우시안 스플랫으로 VFX의 미래를 스캔하다 클리어 앵글이 라이다와 가우시안 스플랫으로 배우와 환경을 스캔해 촬영 현장의 데이터 수집을 바꾼다.
movies.title: Clear Angle on scanning the future of VFX with LiDAR and Gaussian splats
movies.excerpt: Clear Angle Studios has become a key part of the modern VFX pipeline, capturing real-world actors and environments via LiDAR and Gaussian splats for teams to reconstruct in production. A look at how machine-learning-assisted scanning is reshaping on-set data capture for filmmakers and VFX artists.

movies.ko: AI 업스케일링과 복원, 이제 구독제로 바뀐 토파즈 비디오 어도비에 인수된 토파즈 랩스의 토파즈 비디오가 AI 업스케일링과 복원 기능을 구독제로 제공한다.
movies.title: Topaz Video, in depth: AI upscaling and restoration on a new subscription model
movies.excerpt: An in-depth review of Topaz Video, the AI upscaling and restoration tool (noise reduction, de-interlacing, stabilization) now on a subscription model following Adobe's acquisition of Topaz Labs. Details how AI upscaling/restoration fits into real filmmaker and archival workflows.

movies.ko: Dalet Flex LTS, 촬영본부터 배포까지 자동으로 인제스트 단계에서 비전 모델이 메타데이터를 붙이고, Dalia에 자연어로 워크플로를 지시한다.
movies.title: Latest Dalet Flex LTS Boosts AI Workflows, Deepens Dalia Integration
movies.excerpt: Dalet's latest Long-Term Supported release of Dalet Flex introduces intelligent automation across the media production lifecycle, expanding AI-powered capabilities through deeper Dalia integration to streamline workflows from content acquisition through delivery.

movies.ko: 살해 협박 36시간, 구티에레스가 프로젝트를 접었다 아마존 MGM의 생성 AI 애니메이션 발표 뒤 협박과 신상 유출이 이어지자 감독이 스스로 제작을 접었다.
movies.title: 'This Is a Black-and-White Issue': Jorge R. Gutierrez Says Death Threats Drove Decision to Axe His GenAI Animated Project at Amazon
movies.excerpt: Director Jorge R. Gutierrez explains why he walked away from Amazon MGM's generative-AI animation initiative, describing the backlash and threats that followed the announcement. A stark read on how far the creative community's tolerance for genAI-native animation production actually extends.

movies.ko: Griptape Enterprise, 스튜디오가 쓸 모델을 정한다 파이프라인 감독이 아티스트가 쓸 AI 모델을 지정하고, 온프레미스로 IP를 시설 안에 묶어둔다.
movies.title: Foundry Launches Griptape Enterprise for Secure AI-Accelerated VFX Workflows
movies.excerpt: New tier adds studio-controlled licensing, project management and governance tools for high-end media production, giving pipeline supervisors control over which AI models artists use. Studios can run workflows on-premises or in private cloud to keep sensitive IP, prompts and training data inside the facility.

movies.ko: Foundry SmartRoto, 로토의 키프레임만 AI가 맡는다 스플라인 분해는 아티스트가 하고, 지루한 키프레임 작업만 모델이 이어받는 누크용 로토 플러그인이다.
movies.title: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
movies.excerpt: Foundry released SmartRoto, an AI-powered Nuke plugin that accelerates rotoscoping by automating keyframe animation while preserving artist control and precision at image edges. It targets the single most labour-heavy manual task in the VFX pipeline without taking the spline away from the artist.

movies.ko: 파이널 컷 오토 마스크, 추적 없이 매 프레임 인식 사람과 신체 부위, 하늘, 반려동물까지 17종을 프레임마다 인식해 추적 없이 선택 보정을 끝낸다.
movies.title: Great ways to use Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro
movies.excerpt: Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro 12.3 recognizes people, body parts, scene elements and even pets on every frame with no tracking required, opening up fast selective color correction and VFX work. A practical look at ML-driven masking replacing manual roto inside an NLE.

movies.ko: 필 티펫, 스톱모션 '센티넬'에 AI를 더한 과정을 말하다 VFX 거장 필 티펫이 스톱모션 장편 '센티넬'에 AI 도구를 어떻게 접목했는지 시그래프에서 풀어놓는다.
movies.title: Phil Tippett Set for SIGGRAPH Session on LOFTAPPS AI Collab for Stop-Motion Film 'Sentinel'
movies.excerpt: VFX legend Phil Tippett is teaming with production-infrastructure developer LOFTAPPS to discuss how AI tooling supported his stop-motion feature 'Sentinel,' in a SIGGRAPH 2026 session. A rare look at how a hand-crafted stop-motion pipeline folds in AI without surrendering the artist's touch.

movies.ko: 캐나다 NFB, 가우시안 스플래팅 애니메이션을 시그래프로 NFB가 엔비디아 연구진과 함께 촬영부터 납품까지 가우시안 스플래팅 워크플로를 다루는 세션을 시그래프에서 연다.
movies.title: NFB Brings Gaussian Splatting Animation Session to SIGGRAPH
movies.excerpt: The National Film Board of Canada will lead a SIGGRAPH 2026 session on Gaussian-splatting animation workflows and hybrid pipelines, from acquisition through delivery, drawing on works in progress with NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab. A window into an emerging neural-capture technique entering real animation production.

movies.ko: 넷플릭스, 올해만 약 300편에 생성형 AI를 썼다 생성형 AI가 후반 작업을 중심으로 올해 약 300편의 넷플릭스 콘텐츠 제작에 손을 댔다고 회사가 밝혔다.
movies.title: Netflix says it's already used AI in 'roughly 300' titles this year
movies.excerpt: Netflix disclosed that generative-AI workflows touched roughly 300 of its titles this year, concentrated in post-production, with projects like Glory, Brasil 70 and The American Experiment using gen AI for complex sequences. A concrete signal of how deeply AI is now embedded in mainstream production craft.

movies.ko: AI 영상 제작진이 함께 쓰는 공유 촬영장 '마티니'가 열렸다 마티니는 세트와 참고 이미지를 2D·3D 공간에서 숏으로 구성하는 웹 협업 도구로, 무료 인디 요금제와 함께 출시됐다.
movies.title: Meet Martini: A Film Set for AI Video That Aims to Help Filmmakers Streamline Their Shots
movies.excerpt: Martini is a collaborative, web-based platform pitched as a 'film set' for AI video: filmmakers upload their own sets and reference images or generate them, then compose shots in 2D or 3D environments to escape prompt roulette and give crews a shared pre-production hub. Out now with a free indie tier and paid plans from $15/month.

movies.ko: 이번 주 새 AI 영화 도구, 아티스트를 위한 핵심 업데이트 큐리어스 리퓨지가 아티스트를 위해 이번 주 최신 AI 영화 제작 도구를 정리하며, 새 모션 컨트롤 워크플로에 초점을 맞춘다.
movies.title: NEW AI Film Tools: The Biggest Updates for Artists
movies.excerpt: Curious Refuge rounds up the week's biggest AI filmmaking releases for artists, with a focus on new AI motion-control workflows and tool updates that change how creators direct and refine AI-generated shots.

movies.ko: 실사 4K 영상을 언리얼에서 AI로 다시 밝히는 스위치라이트 3 비블 AI가 코리도어 크루의 실사 4K 영상에 스위치라이트 3을 적용해 언리얼 엔진 안에서 바로 쓸 재조명 패스를 만들어냈다.
movies.title: Puget Systems at SIGGRAPH 2026: an immersive Robo Dojo
movies.excerpt: ProVideo Coalition's SIGGRAPH 2026 dispatch spotlights AI-driven creative tools on the show floor: Beeble AI and District Cinema ran the new SwitchLight 3 model on native 4K cinematic footage from Corridor Crew's 'Son of a Dungeon' S3 to generate production-ready PBR relighting passes inside Unreal Engine, and Keyshot Studio's 'AI Shots' made focused generative edits while respecting CAD data and lighting — a concrete look at generative relighting in a real production pipeline.

movies.ko: 실시간 프리비즈 도구 스파크 스토리 베타 열렸다 라이트크래프트의 스파크 스토리는 장면을 블로킹하고 풀 화질 슈퍼데일리를 실시간으로 뽑아 프리비즈 단계를 압축한다.
movies.title: Lightcraft Launches Beta for Spark Story Interactive Previz Tool
movies.excerpt: Lightcraft opened a rolling beta of Spark Story, an interactive previz tool that lets filmmakers block scenes, populate asset libraries and render full-quality 'superdailies' in real time — working with AI or blue/greenscreen keyers to compress previsualization and cut early production costs.

movies.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
movies.excerpt: Beeble unveiled SwitchHDR, an AI model that reconstructs HDR imagery from standard SDR footage, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences for professional VFX and post pipelines. 'Where real detail survives we recover it; where it's fully clipped, the artist decides how it gets rebuilt,' says CEO Hoon Kim.

movies.ko: 어도비 프로젝트 인디고에 생성형 AI 놀이터가 열린다 어도비가 카메라 앱 프로젝트 인디고에 실험적 AI 플레이그라운드를 더해, 촬영 직후 생성형 편집을 곧바로 적용하게 했다.
movies.title: Adobe adds experimental AI Playground to Project Indigo camera app
movies.excerpt: Adobe added an experimental AI Playground to its Project Indigo computational-photography app, letting shooters apply generative editing directly after capture — pushing on-device generative image manipulation well beyond simple style transfer.

movies.ko: 어도비 서브스턴스 3D, 생태계 전반에 OpenPBR 지원 OpenPBR 머티리얼 지원을 넓히고 페인터를 개선해 실사 에셋의 텍스처링 도구를 한층 조인다.
movies.title: Adobe Announces Major Substance 3D Updates Including OpenPBR Support Across Entire Ecosystem
movies.excerpt: Adobe rolled out a major round of Substance 3D updates, headlined by expanded OpenPBR material support and new innovations in Substance 3D Painter, tightening the texturing and look-development toolset that VFX and virtual-production artists rely on for photoreal film assets.

movies.ko: 오토데스크, 마야·3ds Max·아널드에 AI와 가우시안 스플랫 도입 시그래프 2026에서 편집 가능한 가우시안 스플랫과 맞춤 모션 모델로 애니메이션·VFX 작업 흐름을 다듬는다.
movies.title: Autodesk Adds AI and 3DGS Tools Across Maya, 3ds Max and More
movies.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 Autodesk added a 'Bring Your Own Data' feature to Maya's MotionMaker, letting studios train custom generative motion models on their own rigs and mocap, plus editable 3D Gaussian splats in 3ds Max for folding AI-captured environments into shots. A craft-level shift in how animators and VFX artists generate and edit performance and scenes.

movies.ko: HP Z 캡티스와 어도비 서브스턴스, 대규모 디지털 트윈 캡처 더 빠른 캡처와 정밀한 이미징으로 실사 디지털 트윈을 대량 생성해 VFX 파이프라인에 공급한다.
movies.title: HP Z Captis + Adobe Substance 3D: Digital Twin Capture Built for Scale
movies.excerpt: HP and Adobe updated the HP Z Captis capture system with faster speeds and deeper Adobe Substance 3D Sampler integration, running hybrid AI inference on NVIDIA Jetson AGX to build production-ready digital twins for VFX and virtual production. A look at how AI-accelerated asset capture feeds the film pipeline.

movies.ko: 디즈니 주니어와 애니마주가 AI 애니 '오지 폭스' 공개 AI 스튜디오 애니마주가 만든 미취학용 시리즈로, 공개 이틀 만에 조회수 약 80만을 기록했다.
movies.title: Disney Jr. and French AI Animation Outfit Animaj Quietly Release 'Ozzy Fox' on YouTube
movies.excerpt: Disney Jr. and French AI animation company Animaj released a new preschool series, 'Ozzy Fox,' on YouTube, a look at how an AI-driven animation studio is producing kids' content at speed. The show reached nearly 800,000 views within two days of launch.

movies.ko: 블롬캄프의 좀비 AI 단편, 결국 데운 슬롭에 그친다 바이트댄스 시드댄스로 만든 '나이트본'은 텍스트-투-비디오가 아직 좋은 영화를 못 만든다는 증거로 남았다.
movies.title: Neill Blomkamp's New Zombie AI 'Film' Is Just Slop Warmed Over
movies.excerpt: Neill Blomkamp's zombie short 'Nightborne,' produced for AI startup Barley Studios using ByteDance's Seedance generative-video model, becomes a high-profile stress test of AI filmmaking, and lands as evidence that text-to-video generators still can't reliably churn out quality films.

movies.ko: 레인댄스와 IMGN, 인디 감독에게 1만 파운드 펀드와 개발 허브 제34회 레인댄스가 IMGN과 £10,000 펀드를 열고 2027년 각본 공모에 개발 허브를 붙였다.
movies.title: Raindance Film Festival and AI Platform IMGN Launch New Film Fund and Development Hub
movies.excerpt: Raindance Film Festival is partnering with AI platform IMGN to launch a film fund and development hub for indie filmmakers, an institutional push to fold generative-AI tools into how independent films are developed and produced.

movies.ko: 12명이 2주 만에 만든 15분 애니 'Kök Börü' 손그림 캐릭터와 채색 텍스처로 생성 결과를 붙잡아, 열두 명이 2주 만에 15분짜리 애니메이션을 끝냈다.
movies.title: Higgsfield Debuts 'Kök Börü', Showcasing Hybrid Human-AI Animation Pipeline
movies.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026, AI video platform Higgsfield premiered Kök Börü, a 15-minute animated short pairing generative AI with hand-drawn digital animation. Character sheets and environments were generated in Higgsfield's Soul Cartoon (trained on an NVIDIA B300 cluster) then enhanced by artists on Wacom tablets, cutting a 1-2 year, $1-2M production down to about two weeks.

movies.ko: '샤크네이도'와 '닥터후' 작가가 이제 AI 영화를 만든다 Promise AI가 각본가·쇼러너를 생성형 창작자와 짝지어 AI 영화 'Tuning In'을 냈다.
movies.title: Creatives from 'Sharknado' and 'Doctor Who' Are Now Making AI Films
movies.excerpt: For its new slate, the startup Promise AI is pairing traditional screenwriters and showrunners with generative creators — including releasing the animated AI film 'Tuning In' — as a test of what a hybrid AI film crew looks like.

movies.ko: 무료 SAM2 매팅 툴, 머리카락 로토를 몇 시간 줄인다 머리카락 같은 잔털까지 자동으로 따내 손 마스킹에 쓰던 몇 시간을 덜어주는 무료 SAM2 매팅 도구다.
movies.title: FREE SAM2 Matting Tool
movies.excerpt: A free SAM2-based matting tool demoed for AI filmmakers — segmentation-driven roto/matte extraction that slots into a generative-video post workflow.

movies.title: Foundry Adds Griptape Enterprise for Pro-Grade AI in VFX
movies.excerpt: Foundry introduced Griptape Enterprise, a licensing tier for high-end media production with studio-controlled governance, on-prem infrastructure options and security controls that keep sensitive IP inside the facility while enabling AI-integrated creative workflows.

movies.ko: 스파크 스토리 베타 공개 브라우저로 짜는 프리비스 파이널 드래프트 대본을 불러와 장소와 인물을 분석하고 25종 넘는 마블 환경으로 가상 촬영장을 짠다.
movies.title: Lightcraft Technology Opens Spark Story Beta at SIGGRAPH 2026
movies.excerpt: Lightcraft launched a rolling beta of Spark Story, its interactive previs tool, adding a 3D asset library, real-time compositing, Spark Atlas and direct USD loading — pushing generative previsualization closer to a working shot-planning pipeline.

movies.ko: 메시가 3D 생성 AI를 프롬프트에서 창작 파트너로 메시의 3D 에이전트는 대화 맥락을 이어가며 스타일이 일관된 에셋 묶음을 한 번에 만들어낸다.
movies.title: Meshy wants AI to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
movies.excerpt: Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a session so creators can set art direction and generate stylistically consistent, production-ready 3D assets, positioning AI as a creative partner rather than a one-shot prompt.

movies.ko: 루마로 하루 만에 납품용 컷을 뽑는다 서비스플랜 메이크가 루마의 생성형 비디오로 며칠 걸리던 촬영을 하루 만에 납품용 컷으로 끝낸다.
movies.title: How Serviceplan MAKE Uses Luma to Put Creativity First
movies.excerpt: Case study: agency Serviceplan MAKE uses Luma's generative video to visualize concepts and deliver client-ready shots in a single day instead of multi-day studio production. The workflow shift moves time away from execution/post toward concept refinement and faster client feedback.

movies.ko: 그록, 연내 '오디세이'를 장편 영화로 만든다 일론 머스크가 xAI의 그록 이미지가 연말까지 호메로스 '오디세이'를 장편 영화로 만든다고 주장했다.
movies.title: Elon Musk claims Grok will make a 'historically accurate' Odyssey by the end of the year
movies.excerpt: Elon Musk says xAI's Grok Imagine will generate a full-length, 'historically accurate' film adaptation of Homer's Odyssey by year's end, framing generative text-to-video as a rival to Christopher Nolan's theatrical version. The sample footage shown so far has significant quality issues, making the claim a test of how far AI feature generation can actually go.

movies.ko: 검증 안 된 AI 도구는 결국 쌓이는 리스크다 제프 그린버그는 포스트 현장에 쏟아지는 소규모 AI 도구를 믿기 전 다섯 가지를 따져 리스크를 재라고 짚는다.
movies.title: The rise of the independent AI-assisted developer tools: warnings and considerations
movies.excerpt: ProVideo Coalition's Jeff Greenberg examines the flood of small, AI-assisted independent tools now entering post-production pipelines, sorting them into 'Gold Rush' profit plays vs genuine 'Problem Solver' utilities. He lays out five questions editors and facilities should ask before trusting one on client work — maintenance if the developer vanishes, API/platform compatibility, documented failure conditions, credential/data security, and update cadence — arguing that in a craft where reliability is the product, unvetted AI tools are accumulated risk.

movies.ko: 유튜브에서 태어난 AI 장편 극장 개봉을 눈앞에 두다 가십 고블린 채널이 통째로 AI로 만든 장편이 유튜브 구독층을 발판 삼아 극장 개봉으로 넘어갈 채비를 한다.
movies.title: AI feature 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' poised to make the leap from YouTube to the big screen
movies.excerpt: 'Gods Don't Give Gifts,' a fully AI-generated feature from the Gossip Goblin channel, is set to become the next AI film to jump from a large YouTube following to theatrical release — a concrete case study in generative-AI filmmaking reaching mainstream distribution.

movies.ko: 리플 AI 영화제 심사위원에 롭 민코프·캐서린 하드윅 AI 단편을 겨루는 리플 AI 영화제가 롭 민코프와 캐서린 하드윅을 심사위원으로 세웠다.
movies.title: Reply AI Film Festival reveals jury: Rob Minkoff, Catherine Hardwicke
movies.excerpt: Variety reports the Venice-adjacent Reply AI Film Festival for AI-made shorts has revealed its jury, including 'The Lion King' director Rob Minkoff and 'Twilight' director Catherine Hardwicke, ahead of its winners announcement — a marker of established filmmakers engaging with generative-AI short-film craft. (Same festival as the Deadline item; kept for outlet diversity.)

movies.ko: 15년 전통 영화 제작자 이제 마지못해 AI로 간다 무너지는 중예산 영화를 살리려, 15년 경력의 제작자가 마지못해 생성형 AI 제작 도구로 돌아섰다.
movies.title: “I Spent 15 Years Making Movies the Old Way. Now I’m, Reluctantly, an AI Guy”
movies.excerpt: A producer with 15 years of traditional moviemaking experience walks through his shift to generative-AI tools in pre- and post-production, arguing that folding AI into the workflow can lower costs and democratize filmmaking rather than replace human creativity — a first-person view of how AI is reshaping a working film craftsperson's pipeline.

movies.ko: AI 영상을 만든 모델까지 역추적하는 도구 SAGA UC 리버사이드 연구팀이 생성 영상에 남은 시각적 지문을 읽어 원본 모델을 추적한다.
movies.title: This new tool aims to identify and trace AI videos back to their source models
movies.excerpt: A UC Riverside team built SAGA (Source Attribution of Generative AI Videos), one of the first large-scale frameworks to trace an AI-generated clip back to the model that made it by reading the distinctive visual 'fingerprints' each generator leaves behind - a provenance tool with direct implications for deepfakes, rights and AI disclosure in filmmaking.

movies.ko: NVIDIA가 딥페이크 탐지와 AI 에이전트를 함께 열다 엔비디아가 시그래프 2026에서 합성 영상 탐지 NIM과 MCP를 공개했다.
movies.title: NVIDIA tackles deepfakes and opens the door to AI agents at SIGGRAPH 2026
movies.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 NVIDIA introduced a Synthetic Video Detector NIM microservice to help newsrooms and broadcasters flag AI-generated video, and showcased AI-agent integrations (via MCP) reaching into creative tools like Adobe and Unreal Engine - signalling how detection and agentic AI are entering the production and post pipeline.

movies.ko: AI가 배경과 조명을 바꾸는 하이브리드 촬영 현장 비블의 스위치라이트로 배경과 조명은 AI가 바꾸고 배우의 연기와 카메라 워크는 그대로 남긴다.
movies.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?
movies.excerpt: Damian Allen walks through a hybrid AI film-set approach built on Beeble's SwitchLight, where AI transforms backgrounds and relighting while real actor performances and camera work are preserved -- a middle ground between traditional production and fully synthetic generation. A hands-on read on how AI relighting reshapes the on-set and post workflow.

movies.ko: 관객을 메타휴먼으로 바꾸는 퓨젯의 로보 도조 라이다 스캔과 LED 볼륨으로 관객을 실시간 메타휴먼 아바타로 바꿔 AI 로봇과 맞붙게 한다.
movies.title: Puget Systems' Robo Dojo proves SIGGRAPH attendees have all the fun
movies.excerpt: Puget Systems' SIGGRAPH 2026 'Robo Dojo' turns attendees into real-time MetaHuman avatars battling AI robots using LiDAR scanning and LED-volume virtual production, a live demo of markerless motion capture and real-time rendering feeding a game-engine pipeline. A tactile snapshot of where performance capture and virtual production are heading for film.

movies.ko: 장면 단위로 찾는 오프라인 AI 검색 수작업 메타데이터 없이 자연어만으로 영상 라이브러리를 장면 단위로 뒤져 편집자가 필요한 장면을 곧바로 찾는다.
movies.title: Vida Scene Search: AI Scene-Level Search With No Manual Logging Required
movies.excerpt: Vida launched Scene Search, an offline AI-powered indexing tool inside Vida Content OS that lets editors and post teams search a video library at the scene level using natural language, with no manually logged metadata. A concrete craft shift for how film and TV post finds and reuses footage.

movies.ko: AI는 대체가 아니라 또 하나의 도구 에스토니아 FrostFX는 AI로 반복적 기술 작업을 걷어내 아티스트가 창작 판단에 더 오래 머물게 한다고 말한다.
movies.title: Why we chose it: Estonia's FrostFX on using AI as another creative tool in post
movies.excerpt: Estonian VFX studio FrostFX details a post pipeline that treats AI not as a replacement for artists but as a tool that removes repetitive technical work so artists spend more time on creative decisions. A grounded studio-level view of how an AI-assisted VFX workflow actually shifts the craft.

movies.ko: 프롬프트 대신 요소 단위로 고친다 Luma의 Layers는 프롬프트를 통째로 다시 돌리는 대신 AI 이미지를 요소 하나하나 정밀하게 고치게 한다.
movies.title: Introducing Layers
movies.excerpt: Luma AI launched Layers, giving creators precision editing and element-by-element control over any AI-generated image inside its filmmaking toolset, rather than re-rolling a whole prompt. A craft-level capability that pushes generative work toward the directed, revisable control filmmakers and previs artists expect.

movies.ko: 연기를 CG로 옮기되 손은 아티스트가 Wonder Dynamics의 Flow Studio는 실사 연기를 CG 캐릭터로 옮기면서도 아티스트가 통제권을 쥐게 한다.
movies.title: The Filmmakers at Wonder Dynamics Building AI for Filmmakers
movies.excerpt: Wonder Dynamics co-founders Tye Sheridan and Nikola Todorovic discuss how their filmmaking backgrounds shaped Autodesk Flow Studio, an AI tool that transfers live-action performances onto CG characters while keeping artists in control and staying compatible with established VFX pipelines. A grounded look at AI-assisted performance-to-CG as a craft workflow, not a replacement.

movies.ko: 전체 화면 검색과 비교 뷰어 개선 Adobe Frame.io가 전체 화면 검색과 AI 검색 토글, 비교 뷰어 개선으로 촬영본을 더 빠르게 찾고 검토하게 한다.
movies.title: Frame.io adds full-screen search and Comparison Viewer updates
movies.excerpt: Adobe's Frame.io rolls out a dedicated full-screen search page with a toggle between standard and AI-powered search, plus Comparison Viewer updates, letting editors and post teams find and review footage across projects faster. A concrete workflow shift for how film/TV review-and-approval teams navigate media.

movies.ko: 영상 하나로 몸·손·얼굴을 블렌더 안에서 캡처한다 아코메이드의 블렌드캡은 영상 한 편에서 전신·손·표정 움직임을 뽑아 리그에 입힌다. 마커도 슈트도 구독도 없이, 블렌더 안에서 오프라인으로 돌아간다.
movies.title: Full-Body, Hand & Facial Motion Capture From Any Video In Blender
movies.excerpt: Arcomade's BlendCap pulls body, hand, and face motion from a single video and retargets it onto rigs inside Blender, offline, with no markers, suits, or subscriptions.

movies.ko: 말로 시키면 애프터이펙트가 키프레임을 짠다 '공 튀는 애니메이션 만들어줘'라는 말만으로 애프터이펙트 AI 어시스턴트가 40초 만에 물리 키프레임을 짰다. 다만 AI로 만든 서드파티 플러그인이 쏟아지면서 실무에 쓰기 전 검증이 숙제로 남았다.
movies.title: After Effects Portal July 2026
movies.excerpt: After Effects gets an AI Assistant that builds keyframe animation from plain language, plus a flood of AI-built third-party plugins and a sober checklist for vetting them before client work.

movies.ko: AI 얼굴 교체 대신 전통 CG로 되살린 어린 윌 제작진은 ILM·웨타의 AI 얼굴 교체 대신 통제 쉬운 전통 CG 얼굴을 택했다.
movies.title: Vecna, Demogorgons and Young Will: Inside the VFX of Stranger Things S5
movies.excerpt: The Stranger Things S5 VFX team weighed AI/ML face replacement from ILM and Weta FX for young Will's de-aging scenes, but ultimately chose a fully traditional CG face for the creative control it gave the Duffers when specific adjustments were needed.

movies.ko: 베네치아로 가는 AI 단편 심사위원장은 살바토레스 리플 AI 영화제 결선에 3천 편 중 열 편이 올랐고 베네치아에서 수상작을 가린다.
movies.title: Venice-Set Reply AI Film Festival Unveils Finalists & Jury
movies.excerpt: Deadline details the Reply AI Film Festival's finalist shorts and its jury led by Gabriele Salvatores, with Catherine Hardwicke and Jed Weintrob. Winners are announced on the Lido during the Venice Film Festival.

movies.ko: 블렌더 5와 리졸브 21 실루엣의 ML 로토까지 블렌더 5와 리졸브 21도 묵직하지만 리뷰의 축은 실루엣 2026의 ML 로토다.
movies.title: Tech Reviews: Blender 5, Silhouette 2026 and DaVinci Resolve 21
movies.excerpt: Animation Magazine's monthly software review covers Blender 5, Boris FX's Silhouette 2026 and DaVinci Resolve 21 — with Silhouette's machine-learning roto, matting and paint tooling the headline for compositors.

movies.ko: 스냅챗 스포트라이트에서 완전 AI 생성 영상 금지 스냅챗이 스포트라이트에서 전부 AI로 만든 영상을 막고 AI 편집은 허용한다.
movies.title: Snapchat Banning Entirely AI-Generated Videos From Its Spotlight Platform
movies.excerpt: Snap is barring fully AI-generated videos from Spotlight, its short-form discovery surface, while still allowing creators to use AI to edit or enhance footage. It draws a distribution-level line between AI-assisted craft and wholly synthetic output.

movies.ko: 칸에서 마주 앉아 나눈 AI 영화의 솔직한 이야기 칸에서 인디와이어와 a16z가 연 토론에서 창작자와 기술자가 AI의 쓰임을 따졌다.
movies.title: Honest Conversations About AI in Film Often Feel Impossible. IndieWire and Andreessen Horowitz Tried Anyway
movies.excerpt: IndieWire published video from its Cannes event with a16z, where filmmakers and technologists debated where generative tools actually fit in production. The framing: look at the future without pretending human authorship is optional.

movies.ko: 시드댄스 2.5를 가린 건 엔비디아 코스모스 3 슈퍼 이번 주 진짜 사건은 시드댄스 2.5가 아니라 엔비디아의 월드 모델 코스모스 3 슈퍼다.
movies.title: SeedDance 2.5 Just Got Upstaged by Nvidia
movies.excerpt: Curious Refuge stress-tests the freshly launched Seedance 2.5 against Nvidia's newest generative video work, comparing shot control, motion coherence and where each model breaks down for narrative filmmaking.

movies.ko: 손으로 그린 카붐의 윤곽선을 일부러 지우지 않고 남긴 이유 감독 c. Craig는 카붐의 모든 프레임에 아티스트의 손 윤곽선을 남겼다.
movies.title: Practice Makes Magic: The Human Hands Behind ChikaBOOM!
movies.excerpt: Director c. Craig walks through the hand-made animation of Tribeca short ChikaBOOM! and pushes back on calling generative work 'artificial'. His argument: generative tools only hold up when the craft and labour behind them are visible.

movies.ko: 대본을 먼저 채점하는 AI 커버리지 상금은 10만 달러 지분 투자 그린라이트 커버리지가 데이터 사이언스로 시나리오를 채점해 관객과 배급을 가늠한다.
movies.title: From Script to $100K Equity Financing: Navigating The Greenlight List
movies.excerpt: A look at AI-assisted script coverage: Greenlight Coverage scores screenplays with data science to estimate audience and distribution before a frame is shot. Development notes move from taste to model output.

movies.ko: 유튜브가 그은 AI 슬롭의 선 어떤 AI 영상은 수익이 끊긴다 유튜브가 대량 생산 클립과 반복 템플릿, 가짜 조언 페르소나를 수익화에서 뺐다.
movies.title: YouTube explains its AI slop policy and why some creators won't get paid
movies.excerpt: YouTube spelled out how its monetisation rules treat AI-generated content, drawing a line between augmented creative work and mass-produced synthetic uploads that lose revenue eligibility.

movies.ko: 말로 시키면 어도비가 움직인다 ChatGPT에 들어온 통합 플러그인 어도비가 도구 70여 종을 플러그인 하나로 묶어 ChatGPT 안에 들여놓았다.
movies.title: Adobe Announces It Is Further Integrating Into ChatGPT With New Unified Plugin
movies.excerpt: Adobe and OpenAI have shipped a single unified plugin that exposes more than 70 Creative Cloud and productivity tools inside ChatGPT. Filmmakers can now describe an outcome and let the chatbot orchestrate which Adobe app actually does the work.

movies.ko: 픽사를 세운 에드 캣멀이 생성형 AI 영화제 심사석에 픽사 공동창업자 에드 캣멀이 생성형 AI 영화만 겨루는 경연의 심사석에 앉았다.
movies.title: Pixar Co-Founder Ed Catmull Joins Jury For GenAI Film Competition
movies.excerpt: Pixar co-founder and former Disney Animation president Ed Catmull has joined the jury of the Higgsfield Global Film Festival, a competition devoted entirely to generative-AI filmmaking. Higgsfield framed the move around Pixar's history of pairing artists with engineers.

movies.ko: 디즈니 자산으로 만든 팬 영상이 디즈니+ 세로 피드에 걸린다 디즈니와 TikTok이 팬이 만든 세로 영상을 Disney+ 피드에 함께 싣는다.
movies.title: Disney And TikTok Strike Deal To Bring Fan-Made Short-Form Videos To Disney+
movies.excerpt: Disney and TikTok will let creators build short-form videos from hundreds of official Disney assets, with selected results surfacing on Disney+'s vertical feed. Cartoon Brew contrasts it with the abandoned Disney–Sora deal: this one is asset remixing, not text-to-video generation.

movies.ko: 자막부터 세로 리프레임까지 Premiere Pro 패널 하나로 Brevidy가 자막, 세로 리프레임, 클립 추출을 프리미어 프로 패널에 담았다.
movies.title: Brevidy for Adobe Premiere Pro – AI Captions, Automatic Social Clips, and Vertical Reframing in One Panel
movies.excerpt: Brevidy is an AI toolkit that lives inside Adobe Premiere Pro, handling captioning, automatic clip extraction from long-form edits, vertical reframing and stock browsing in one panel. It targets the export-upload-reimport loop editors currently run for short-form deliverables.

movies.ko: 중국 미니맥스 H3로 만든 짝퉁 '오피스'가 퍼진다 디즈니·유니버설·워너의 소송 중에도 H3가 만든 무단 클립이 확산된다.
movies.excerpt: Bootleg 'The Office' and 'Friends' clips generated with China's MiniMax H3 are going viral outside China, reminding studios how hard IP policing is when a video model can reproduce a show's look, cast and staging on demand.

movies.ko: 시그래프 2026, 전시장은 줄고 무게추는 세션으로 옮겨갔다 69개국 9,500명이 모였지만 화제는 부스가 아니라 AI 세션이었다.
movies.excerpt: VFX supervisor Todd Sheridan Perry gives an honest, artist-side read on SIGGRAPH 2026 in LA — what the neural rendering, gaussian splat and AI-assisted animation demos actually mean for production pipelines.

movies.ko: 오토데스크 플로우 스튜디오, 생성 컷을 3D에서 연출한다 3D 에디터에서 인물과 카메라를 직접 배치하면 AI가 최종 렌더링을 맡는다.
movies.title: Autodesk's New Flow Studio Tools Let Creators Block and Direct AI Shots in 3D
movies.excerpt: Autodesk's Flow Studio release adds a 3D Editor plus a node-based 2D Canvas, bringing characters, environments, animation, camera tracks and AI mocap data into one workspace. AWN notes it lays groundwork for expanded Maya/DCC integrations, AI-assisted scene construction and agent-driven directing.

movies.ko: 일라이 로스, '아이스크림 맨' 생성 AI 사용을 뒤늦게 인정 손으로 그렸다던 애니메이션 장면에 생성 AI를 썼다고 로스가 정정했다.
movies.title: Eli Roth Confirms 'Ice Cream Man' GenAI Use After First Describing A Traditional Animation Process
movies.excerpt: Eli Roth first described the animated sequences in his horror feature 'Ice Cream Man' as a traditional hand-drawn process, then confirmed generative AI was used in "a very small portion of a few scenes." The reversal reopens the question of how directors disclose AI in credited animation work.

movies.ko: 런웨이에 시드댄스 2.5, 30초 한 컷 생성이 열렸다 런웨이 안에서 최대 50개 레퍼런스로 30초 단일 샷을 소리까지 붙여 만든다.
movies.title: Seedance 2.5 is Now Available on Runway
movies.excerpt: Runway announces ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is now available inside its platform, putting 30-second single-shot generation and 3D camera blockouts alongside Runway's own tools in one filmmaking workspace.

movies.ko: BAFTA TV 어워즈, 출품작에 쓴 생성형 AI를 캐묻는다 출품 규정에 AI 조항이 붙어 제작진은 생성형 AI를 어디에 썼는지 밝혀야 한다.
movies.title: BAFTA TV Awards Adds AI Clause To Entry Rules & Welcomes Submissions From HBO Max
movies.excerpt: The BAFTA TV Awards has added an AI clause to its entry rules, requiring entrants to account for generative AI used in a production. HBO Max shows also become eligible for the first time.

movies.ko: 히그스필드, N3on과 UFC 선수 AI 아바타 초상권 계약을 맺다 히그스필드가 N3on과 UFC 아데산야·잭슨을 두고 AI 아바타 초상권 계약을 맺었다.
movies.title: Why Higgsfield Inked Deals for AI Avatars of Streamer N3on, UFC's Israel Adesanya and Quinton 'Rampage' Jackson
movies.excerpt: Higgsfield signed licensing deals for AI avatars of streamer N3on, UFC's Israel Adesanya and Quinton 'Rampage' Jackson for a new feature — a test of how public figures get paid when their likeness and scripts are adapted with generative AI.

movies.ko: 구글 플로우 세션, 신진 영화인에게 6주간 Flow를 무제한으로 연다 구글은 신진 영화인에게 6주 동안 Flow를 열어주고 단편 11편을 극장에 걸었다.
movies.title: Inside Google's Efforts to Get Creatives Hooked on AI
movies.excerpt: Inside Google's Flow Sessions, the residency-style program that hands filmmakers Veo and Flow and screens the results. It doubles as a showcase for how badly Google wants the film industry to build on its generative video stack.

movies.ko: 프리미어 네이티브 AI 마스킹에 리졸브의 겹친 연기까지 붙었다 프리미어의 네이티브 AI 객체 마스킹과 리졸브의 겹친 연기 다루는 법이 강의에 새로 붙었다.
movies.excerpt: MZed's AI Masking course adds lessons on Premiere Pro's native AI object masking and on handling overlapping performances in DaVinci Resolve. The update tracks how fast AI roto and masking are being absorbed into standard NLE workflows.

movies.ko: xAI의 새 영상 툴, 편집을 버텨내는지 직접 돌려봤다 xAI의 새 영상 툴을 샷 제어와 일관성 기준으로 지금 선두 모델과 하나씩 견줬다.
movies.excerpt: A hands-on test of xAI's new AI video tool from a filmmaking perspective, judging shot control, consistency and whether the output survives an edit. Curious Refuge compares it against the current model leaders.

movies.ko: AI 회의론자 그렉 아라키가 후반 작업 한 대목에서 손을 빌렸다 고속도로 옆에서 찍은 미니골프 장면이 후반 도구를 거치자 귀뚜라미 소리만 남았다.
movies.excerpt: Gregg Araki says he is 'not a big supporter' of AI but found it genuinely useful in the edit on 'I Want Your Sex,' using it to solve a scene he could not otherwise cut. A rare concrete account of AI inside an auteur's post workflow.

movies.ko: 워너브러더스, 신작 홍보 영상에 AI 강아지 팟캐스트를 내세웠다 AI 골든리트리버가 진행하는 90초 팟캐스트가 워너의 공식 홍보물로 나왔다.
movies.excerpt: Warner Bros. built a campaign for the Anne Hathaway/Ewan McGregor sci-fi film 'The End of Oak Street' around an AI-generated talking-dog podcast. A studio marketing department using generative video as a first-class promo format, not a test.

movies.ko: 에드가르 페라가 AI 이미지로 AI의 위험을 정면으로 겨눈다 실제 역사와 허구, AI 이미지를 섞은 신작이 로카르노에서 처음 공개된다.
movies.title: 'Asphalt Guerrilla' Blends Fact, Fiction, AI and a Story About Filmmaking to Hold Up a Mirror to Our Time
movies.excerpt: Portuguese auteur Edgar Pera discusses 'Asphalt Guerrilla,' premiering at Locarno, which blends fact, fiction and AI-generated imagery into a story about filmmaking. He explains how he uses AI as a craft tool precisely to argue against it.

movies.ko: 로쿠가 종일 AI 영상만 트는 무료 채널 페어그라운드를 열었다 한 시간을 지켜본 결과, 채널을 채운 건 텍스트-투-비디오 특유의 슬롭이었다.
movies.excerpt: Roku has launched Fairground, a free ad-supported channel of fully AI-generated programming, and the viewing experience is grim. An early read on what happens when generative video is scheduled as linear television.

movies.ko: AI 스튜디오 프로미스가 ‘죽은 인터넷 이론’ 호러 장편을 만든다 프로미스의 데이브 클라크가 죽은 인터넷 이론을 소재로 한 호러 장편을 연출한다.
movies.title: Promise AI Developing Horror Feature 'Touch Grass'; Dave Clark Directing
movies.excerpt: AI studio Promise is developing an original horror feature with 'Backrooms' filmmaker Dave Clark directing, produced with Bloody Disgusting. It is another test of whether a generative-first pipeline can carry a full narrative feature rather than a short.

movies.ko: AI 스튜디오 아스테리아가 버추얼 프로덕션 제로스페이스와 손잡았다 아스테리아가 제로스페이스와 손잡고 각자의 AI 운영체제와 생성 플랫폼을 서로 연다.
movies.title: AI Studio Asteria Strikes Strategic Partnership With Virtual Production Studio ZeroSpace
movies.excerpt: Asteria, the AI studio co-founded by Bryn Mooser and Natasha Lyonne, has struck a strategic partnership with virtual production studio ZeroSpace. The deal pairs Asteria's clean-trained generative models with ZeroSpace's stage, mocap and volumetric capture pipeline.

movies.ko: 디즈니가 SEC 서한에 ILM과 픽사를 AI 투자처로 이름 올렸다 AI 투자처로 ILM과 픽사를 적은 서한에 인력 감축 검토도 함께 담겼다.
movies.title: ILM and Pixar Named in Disney's AI Push as Cost Cuts Continue
movies.excerpt: An SEC filing names ILM and Pixar among the units getting machine-learning investment inside Disney, alongside Disney Research Studios and Imagineering. Disney pledges a process that stays "human-centered, artist-driven," landing right after job cuts.

movies.ko: HBO 맥스가 세로형 숏츠와 AI 대화형 검색을 함께 열었다 사내 AI 도구가 방대한 카탈로그에서 장면을 골라 세로 화면으로 잘라 낸다.
movies.title: HBO Max Dips Toe Into Vertical Video With 'HBO Max Shorts' and New AI-Driven Features
movies.excerpt: HBO Max is launching a vertical 'Shorts' feed alongside AI-driven conversational search and discovery features. A streamer reformatting premium catalogue for vertical playback changes the framing and cutdown work asked of editors and promo teams.

movies.ko: 런웨이가 중세 코미디 단편을 첫 아이디어부터 완성까지 보여준다 캐릭터 디자인부터 대사 연출까지 단편 한 편을 짓는 과정을 런웨이가 공개했다.
movies.title: Creating an AI Short Film (Full Workflow) | Runway
movies.excerpt: Runway publishes an end-to-end production walkthrough for an AI short film, from idea through shot generation and edit. Useful as a concrete look at where generative video now fits in a real creative pipeline rather than a demo reel.

movies.ko: 피콕이 첫 연재형 모바일 게임 〈퍼블릭 아이〉를 내놨다 울프 게임스와 만든 10부작 살인 미스터리에 생성형 AI 비주얼이 들어갔다.
movies.title: Peacock Launches First Serialized Mobile Game 'Public Eye'
movies.excerpt: Peacock's first episodic interactive title comes out of NBCUniversal's pact with Wolf Games, the generative-AI startup co-founded by Elliot Wolf. It is a test of AI-generated serialized storytelling built by a TV production house.

movies.ko: 누라 스튜디오가 스톱모션처럼 보이는 AI 시리즈 〈레인보우 할로〉를 냈다 장례식장에서 떠오른 아이디어가 스톱모션을 닮은 AI 다크 코미디 세 편이 됐다.
movies.title: Nura Studios Debuts 'Rainbow Hollow' Stop-Motion Styled AI Series
movies.excerpt: Noah Wagner's new series was produced on Nura's Showcraft platform, which handles story, layout, animation, edit and post finishing inside one environment. The system opens to the public in early September.

movies.ko: 임파서블 오브젝츠가 AI 모델을 스튜디오 안에서 직접 돌린다 HP ZGX 나노를 사내에 두고 컴포지팅 파이프라인 안에서 생성 단계를 돌린다.
movies.title: Impossible Objects superpowers VFX production with AI models running on HP ZGX Nano
movies.excerpt: LA studio Impossible Objects is running AI models locally on HP ZGX Nano desktops, folding artist-driven generative workflows in alongside traditional VFX tools without shipping client plates to the cloud.

movies.ko: 다큐 팀에 AI를 언제 어떻게 꺼야 하는지 알려 주는 무료 강의 필드 오브 비전과 언론자유재단이 9월 10일 AI 옵트아웃 세션을 연다.
movies.title: A New Free Seminar Teaches Documentary Filmmakers When and How to Opt Out of AI
movies.excerpt: Field of Vision and Freedom of the Press Foundation are running the sixth edition of their Digital Security Clinic, this time on AI. It walks documentary teams through where AI enters their pipeline and how to opt out of it.

movies.ko: 시드댄스 2.5가 할리우드 판박이 프롬프트를 막는다 시드댄스 2.5가 할리우드 IP와 배우 얼굴을 재현하는 프롬프트를 이제 거부한다.
movies.title: After Chaos Of Cruise Vs Pitt AI Deepfakes, Seedance 2.5 Is Now Blocking Hollywood Rip-Offs
movies.excerpt: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is now refusing prompts that reproduce Hollywood IP and star likenesses, after Seedance 2.0 triggered an outrage cycle over Cruise-vs-Pitt deepfakes. A rare look at guardrails being retrofitted into a mainstream video model creators actually use.

movies.ko: 생성형 AI로 만든 터키 사극이 프라임 비디오에 올라왔다 생성형 AI로 전편을 만든 터키 사극이 프라임 비디오에 첫 사례로 올라왔다.
movies.title: AI-Generated Turkish Series 'Castle Walls' Launches on Prime Video in What Is Being Touted as a First
movies.excerpt: AI-generated historical drama 'Castle Walls,' produced by Turkish TV powerhouse Ay Yapim, launches on Prime Video as what is billed as the first series made end-to-end with generative AI for a major streamer. It is a concrete test of whether a fully synthetic production pipeline can carry a scripted series.

movies.ko: 캐스케이더 2026.2에 애니메이션 레이어와 MCP 서버가 들어왔다 애니메이션 레이어와 이징이 붙었고, 내장 MCP 서버로 외부 AI 도구가 조작한다.
movies.title: Cascadeur Ships 2026.2 with Animation Layers and 3 New Languages
movies.excerpt: Nekki's physics- and AI-assisted character animation tool adds additive animation layers, easing controls, retrained inbetweening/motion-generation/retargeting networks, and a built-in MCP server that lets external AI agents drive the software. A concrete look at where neural assistance sits inside a working animation pipeline.

movies.ko: AI가 알아서 따라가는 50배 줌 카메라가 킥스타터로 간다 AI 피사체 추적으로 프레이밍을 맡는 50배 줌 로봇 카메라가 킥스타터에 오른다.
movies.title: RocXZoom Heading to Kickstarter – Robotic 50x Zoom Camera With AI Subject Tracking From Ex-DJI Engineers
movies.excerpt: Ex-DJI engineers are crowdfunding RocXZoom, a robotic 50x zoom camera whose AI subject tracking handles framing and follow automatically. On-set machine vision is moving from post into the camera body itself.

movies.ko: 감독이 젊은 빌리 조엘을 동의 없이 AI로 되살렸다 잃어버린 라디오 인터뷰를 찾은 감독이 젊은 빌리 조엘을 동의 없이 AI로 되살렸다.
movies.title: A Filmmaker Secured a Lost Billy Joel Radio Interview. Then He Re-Created the Singer in AI
movies.excerpt: A documentary filmmaker found a lost Billy Joel radio interview and used AI to reconstruct a young Billy Joel on screen — without the artist's involvement. A sharp case study in the consent gap opening up around AI-assisted documentary reenactment.

movies.ko: 감독과 편집자에게 VFX 공정을 가르치는 액션VFX 온라인 강의가 열렸다 뎁스맵과 AI 로토, 컨텐트 어웨어 필을 기본 공정으로 가르친다.
movies.excerpt: ActionVFX launched an online 'VFX for Filmmakers' course aimed at directors and producers who aren't VFX artists, built around After Effects and Photoshop. Its "Modern AI Integration" module teaches depth-map generation, AI-assisted rotoscoping, content-aware fill and LLM-assisted troubleshooting as standard craft steps.

movies.ko: 달레가 자연어로 아카이브를 뒤지는 클라우드 스위트를 열었다 달리아에게 말을 걸면 영상 검색과 메타데이터 보강, 포스트 워크플로가 돌아간다.
movies.excerpt: Dalet launched cloud-native solution suites on its Flex platform with preconfigured workflows and agentic AI built in. The suites center on Dalia, a media-aware AI assistant that lets teams search video libraries, enrich metadata and trigger post/archive workflows through natural language.

movies.ko: AI 크리에이티브 서밋이 규제와 스킬 갭을 정식 의제로 올렸다 11월 11일 BFI 사우스뱅크 전관에서 워크플로와 권리, 인력 세 갈래를 다룬다.
movies.excerpt: The expanded 2026 AI Creative Summit lands at BFI Southbank on November 11 with three streams covering production workflows, rights and responsible AI, and the skills gap. The programme signals where UK film and TV craft training is being redirected as gen-AI tools move into normal post pipelines.

movies.ko: 엔비디아가 AI 생성 영상을 인제스트에서 걸러내는 검출기를 냈다 1080p를 22밀리초에 판정해 최대 92% 정확도로 합성 영상을 가려낸다.
movies.excerpt: NVIDIA released a Synthetic Video Detector NIM microservice that flags AI-generated footage with up to 92% accuracy on uncompressed material, processing 1080p in 22ms on RTX systems. It is pitched at newsrooms and post teams that now need a provenance check inside the ingest pipeline.

movies.ko: '1년 무제한'을 판 아트리스트가 일주일 만에 시드댄스를 뺐다 초당 추론 단가를 계산하면 연 500달러짜리 무제한은 처음부터 성립하지 않았다.
movies.excerpt: Artlist sold filmmakers a year of "unlimited" access to ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model for $500, then pulled the unlimited tier within days and swapped it for a modest credit allowance. CineD's breakdown shows the per-second inference economics made the offer impossible from day one — a warning about how gen-video pricing is being marketed to creators.

movies.ko: 로빈 윌리엄스의 세 자녀가 AI 남용에 맞서 아버지의 인스타그램을 열었다 젤다 윌리엄스는 진짜 클립과 사진을 모으는 일이 아버지의 목소리와 초상 남용에 맞서는 최선이라고 적었다.
movies.excerpt: Robin Williams' children revived his Instagram account as a hub for his legacy and a countermeasure to what they call the 'rampant AI abuse' of his likeness. It is a working example of estates using owned channels as posthumous likeness governance in the AI-slop era.

movies.ko: 실사 '모아나' 현장에서 뷰스크린이 용암 괴물을 카메라에 실시간으로 넣었다 블루스크린 앞에서 감독과 촬영감독이 합성된 바다와 500피트 용암 괴물을 보며 프레이밍을 잡았다.
movies.excerpt: Seth MacFarlane's Fuzzy Door Technology ran its ViewScreen real-time visualization suite on Disney's live-action 'Moana,' feeding oceans, skies, a treasure cave and a 500-foot lava monster into the camera on set. Departments could judge blocking, lighting and framing against the finished world during the shoot rather than months later in post.

movies.ko: 지브리는 차기작을 정하지 않았고 AI 자체에는 반대하지 않는다 미야자키 고로는 스튜디오가 기술 자체를 부정하지도, 부정적으로 느끼지도 않는다고 말했다.
movies.excerpt: A new report goes inside Studio Ghibli as it plans its next film, names no successor to Hayao Miyazaki, and restates its position on AI. The studio's refusal of a master plan reads as a deliberate counter-model to AI-accelerated animation pipelines.

movies.ko: MPA가 바이트댄스와 양해각서를 맺고 시드댄스에 IP 가드레일을 박았다 MPA와 바이트댄스가 시드댄스와 시드림에 할리우드 저작권을 지키는 가드레일을 두기로 합의했다.
movies.excerpt: The Motion Picture Association and ByteDance signed a memorandum of understanding to protect film and TV intellectual property across ByteDance's generative products, covering the Seedance video models, Seedream image models, TikTok and more. It follows the February cease-and-desist over Seedance 2.0 deepfakes and sets the first studio-side guardrails for a mainstream video model.

movies.ko: 디스크립트 더빙은 로토스코핑이 아니라 화자의 얼굴 아랫부분을 새로 만든다 원본 얼굴을 잠재 공간에 넣고 조명과 치아, 인물 정체성은 그대로 둔 채 입 모양만 새 언어에 맞춘다.
movies.excerpt: Allan Tepper tests Descript's translation and dubbing feature and finds it is not rotoscoping at all: the model encodes the speaker's face into a latent space and regenerates the lower half of the face so mouth movement follows the new language while lighting, teeth and identity hold. A concrete look at how generative visual dubbing now works inside a mainstream editing app.

movies.ko: 전 루마 AI 임원 베레나 품이 LA에 제작사 매트리아크 설립 루마 AI 드림랩을 이끌던 베레나 품이 AI 제작사 매트리아크를 세웠다.
movies.title: Former Luma AI Exec Launches L.A.-Based Production Outfit Matriarch
movies.excerpt: Filmmaker and former Luma AI executive Verena Puhm has launched LA-based Matriarch to produce AI-native and hybrid projects, including work for brands and third parties. A tool-vendor insider crossing over into production is a signal of where AI-native studio craft is heading.

movies.ko: 원격 편집자가 남의 드라이브에서 바로 자르는 Strada 2.0 협업자의 저장장치를 가상 드라이브로 붙여 원본을 옮기지 않고 원격 편집을 한다.
movies.excerpt: Strada 2.0 mounts a collaborator's storage as a virtual drive so a remote editor can cut from media that never leaves the original disk, on top of the platform's AI tagging and search layer. It targets the real bottleneck in AI-assisted post: moving the footage, not the metadata.

movies.ko: 특수분장 거장 릭 베이커가 말하는 AI와 CGI, 손으로 만든 얼굴 로카르노 비전상을 받은 릭 베이커가 실사로 될 일을 CGI로 하는 관행을 짚었다.
movies.title: Hollywood Makeup Pioneer Rick Baker Shares His Thoughts on AI, CGI and Stories About Eddie Murphy
movies.excerpt: Honored at Locarno 2026, makeup legend Rick Baker gives his verdict on AI and CGI and makes a case for the below-the-line experts he says go unappreciated. A practical-effects master's read on where machine imagery leaves hand-built craft.

movies.ko: AI로 되살린 발 킬머의 젊은 시절 7분 분량 푸티지가 처음 공개 유족 동의를 받은 AI 발 킬머가 신부 핀탄으로 등장하는 7분 클립이 공개됐다.
movies.excerpt: 'As Deep as the Grave' has released seven minutes of footage built around an AI-generated younger Val Kilmer, the late actor's estate-approved posthumous 'performance.' It is the most concrete public look yet at how a digital-replica lead is actually assembled, lit and cut into a narrative film.

movies.ko: Wan 3.0은 레퍼런스에 강하고 립싱크와 캐릭터 일관성에 약했다 레퍼런스가 많은 장면은 잘 뽑았지만 립싱크와 캐릭터 일관성은 무너졌다.
movies.excerpt: An honest hands-on review of Wan 3.0, the video model Curious Refuge calls the best generator most filmmakers have not tried yet. Covers where it holds up on motion and character consistency in an actual shot workflow.

movies.ko: Firefly의 음악·음성·효과음 생성이 베타를 벗고 정식 버전이 됐다 어도비가 Firefly의 음악·음성·효과음 생성을 모두 정식 기능으로 돌렸다.
movies.title: Adobe Firefly's Generate Music, Speech and Sound Effects go GA, with a free tier for the AI Assistant
movies.excerpt: Adobe pushed Firefly's Generate Music, Generate Speech and Generate Sound Effects to general availability, added more third-party AI models and opened Firefly AI Assistant in a free tier. Sound-post relevance: score, VO and SFX generation now sit inside the same tool video editors already use.

movies.ko: MetaBull, Inkrise 인수 결정론적 렌더링 쪽에 선다 MetaBull이 Inkrise를 품으며 결정론적 AIR 렌더링 엔진까지 손에 넣었다.
movies.title: MetaBull acquires Inkrise and its deterministic AIR rendering engine, names Aaron Simpson head of production
movies.excerpt: AI-animation studio Inkrise folds into MetaBull Labs, taking its Felix pipeline tool and deterministic AIR rendering engine with it. MetaBull argues deterministic rendering from layout, storyboard and animation data holds character and narrative continuity that text-to-video models cannot.

movies.ko: Eddie AI, 로컬에서 돌아가는 9B 편집 전용 모델을 학습했다 9B 편집 전용 모델이 Kimi K3를 상대로 47% 승률을 냈다. 워크스테이션 한 대면 돈다.
movies.title: Eddie AI trains an editing model small enough to run locally, claims a 47% win rate against Kimi K3
movies.excerpt: Eddie AI says its purpose-built 9B editing model hit a 47% win rate against Kimi K3 while being small enough to run on-premises, pointing at private, personalized assembly-edit assistants for post houses.

movies.ko: 제임스 그레이, AI 몰이는 실패하고 필름은 바이닐처럼 돌아온다 '페이퍼 타이거'를 필름으로 찍은 그는 AI 몰이가 실패하고 필름이 돌아온다고 본다.
movies.title: James Gray says the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and film will come back like vinyl
movies.excerpt: James Gray, who returned to celluloid and vintage tools on 'Paper Tiger,' predicts the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and that shooting on film will stage a vinyl-style comeback. A counter-position piece on craft value as generative tooling spreads.

movies.ko: ComfyUI에 공식 MCP 서버 노드 그래프를 에이전트가 짠다 공식 MCP 서버가 붙었다. 노드 배선은 에이전트가 맡고 연출은 사람 몫으로 남는다.
movies.title: ComfyUI ships an official MCP server — Claude or Codex can now build and repair your node graphs
movies.excerpt: ComfyUI shipped an official MCP server, so Claude or Codex can build, run and repair ComfyUI graphs while the filmmaker keeps the creative half. Walks through what agent-driven node graphs mean for a solo AI-video pipeline.

movies.ko: 리얼루전 AccuFACE 2 출시 웹캠·아이폰으로 잡는 표정 모캡 리얼루전이 웹캠이나 아이폰 촬영만으로 CC5 HD 캐릭터급 표정을 잡아내는 프로덕션급 마커리스 안면 모캡 AccuFACE 2를 출시했다.
movies.title: Reallusion launches AccuFACE 2, production-grade markerless facial mocap from a webcam or iPhone
movies.excerpt: Reallusion launched AccuFACE 2, an AI-driven markerless facial mocap system aimed at production-grade performance capture for CC5 HD characters from ordinary webcam or iPhone capture. It targets small teams doing character animation without a mocap stage.

movies.title: Roku's Fairground AI is a 24/7 free channel programmed entirely with AI-generated shorts
movies.excerpt: Roku launched Fairground AI, a 24/7 free channel programmed entirely with AI-generated narrative shorts and commercials. It's the first mainstream US distribution slot built purely for synthetic video, and a live read on whether audiences will sit with it.

movies.ko: SubtitleNext, AI 전사엔진 4종과 IMSCR·일괄처리까지 통합 프로퍼즈디지털이 SubtitleNext에 AI 전사 엔진 네 개와 IMSCR 지원, 일괄 처리 기능을 새로 얹었다.
movies.title: SubtitleNext wires AssemblyAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs and Whisper into subtitling, plus IMSCR and batch runs
movies.excerpt: Profuz Digital's SubtitleNext adds expanded AI transcription integrations with AssemblyAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs and Whisper, plus IMSCR support and batch processing for subtitle and audio-description work. It points at AI moving into routine localization pipelines rather than hero shots.

movies.ko: LTX-2.5, 오픈웨이트 영상 월드모델 스튜디오 자체 하드웨어에 올라간다 LTX가 내놓은 LTX-2.5는 오픈웨이트로 ACES HDR과 멀티샷 시퀀스를 한 번에 처리해 스튜디오 자체 서버에 바로 올릴 수 있다.
movies.title: LTX releases LTX-2.5, an open-weights video world model studios can run on their own hardware
movies.excerpt: LTX released LTX-2.5, an open-weights video world model studios can run on their own hardware, keeping IP and prompts in-house. It handles ACES HDR end to end and renders multishot sequences as a single output; available now via Hugging Face, the LTX API and ComfyUI.

movies.ko: 런웨이 Ruby, 어떤 모델 영상도 16비트 HDR로 바꿔낸다 런웨이 Ruby는 다른 모델이 만든 영상까지 16비트 HDR 프로레스와 EXR로 바꿔 그레이딩에 바로 태운다.
movies.title: Runway's Ruby outputs 16-bit HDR ProRes and EXR from any video model, not just its own
movies.excerpt: Runway introduced Ruby, a model that generates 16-bit HDR ProRes and EXR sequences directly, or converts existing clips and generations into them.
